text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I can't stop thinking about the Special Carrot Overload Set that Oguri's eating…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But I've got a race coming up, so I can't eat too much, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But… it's all I can think about!
choice_data_list: It's important for your meals to be balanced right now!
You'll be fine as long as you exercise afterward!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Y-you're right… I guess I'll pass for today…
choice_data_list: We can chow down once you win your race!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okey dokey! Then I'll make sure to win!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You're right! After all, they say it's bad to never treat yourself!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It won't be a problem as long as I burn the calories during training!
